subject: Social Media
title: The Anxious Generation
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Anxious Generation.

hook.text: Teen depression doubled between 2012 and 2022. Jonathan Haidt points at one thing: smartphones.

buildup.text: Haidt argues the shift to phone-based childhood—always online, rarely unsupervised play—rewired a generation.

discovery.text: Girls were hit hardest. Self-harm among teen girls tripled in the decade after Instagram launched.

twist.text: Critics say Haidt overstates the link. Correlation isn't causation. Economic stress and other factors matter too.

climax.text: Regardless of cause, the crisis is real. Youth mental health systems are overwhelmed across every country.

punchline.text: Something broke. The phones were there when it did.

quiz.question: What claim does Jonathan Haidt make about teen mental health?
options: Smartphones drove the decline starting around 2012
